title: kb-tests-windows runs without a click on tool changes
goal: kb-tests-windows starts on its own (when: on_success, allow_failure: true kept) for a push to a branch that changes _tools, .claude, .claude-plugin, .githooks, .gitlab-ci.yml, pyproject.toml or uv.lock, on the project's docker-windows runner, and kb/_self/git.md says so; red-pipeline still never counts it as a gate job.

run: import re,pathlib;t=pathlib.Path('.gitlab-ci.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8');b=re.search(r'(?ms)^kb-tests-windows:\n.*?(?=^\S)',t).group(0);r=b.split('rules:',1)[1];assert 'when: manual' not in r and 'when: on_success' in r and 'allow_failure: true' in r,r

notes: Both CI stories edit the kb-tests-windows block, so this one follows ST-jewmfu3n. The job runs on the project's docker-windows runner (ST-qmusneyk), not GitLab.com's hosted Windows runners, so an automatic run spends that runner's time, not the namespace's compute minutes. An optional job (allow_failure: true) does not count toward the pipeline status (gitlab/automated-merge-requests, DOC S-4darq3cp); red-pipeline never makes a pipeline unverified over kb-tests-windows.
